hdr.poweroff_title.en: Safely power off the RPi (sync + poweroff)

poweroff.confirm.sl:
Ugasnem Raspberry Pi?

Najprej se sinhronizira disk, nato se RPi ugasne. Šele potem izklopi napajanje.

Nadaljujem?
poweroff.confirm.en:
Power off the Raspberry Pi?

The disk is synced first, then the RPi powers off. Only then cut the power supply.

Continue?

poweroff.armed_confirm.en:
Pixhawk is ARMED!

Power off anyway? (force)

dash.mission_hint.sl: Najprej se poveži s Pixhawkom, nato izberi misijo in pošlji.
dash.mission_hint.en: First connect to the Pixhawk, then select a mission and upload.

dash.control_login_required.sl: Za upravljanje letalnika je potrebna prijava.
dash.control_login_required.en: Sign in is required to control the aircraft.

dash.control_hint.sl: Propelerji! Pred armanjem preveri, da je območje prosto.
dash.control_hint.en: Propellers! Before arming, make sure the area is clear.

dash.log_hint.sl: Zapis se samodejno začne ob armanju in zaključi ob dis-armanju.
dash.log_hint.en: Recording starts automatically on arming and stops on disarming.

dash.camera_hint.sl: Gumb na videu shrani trenutni okvir.
dash.camera_hint.en: The button on the video saves the current frame.

dash.camera_login_required.en: Sign in is required to capture.

dash.system_hint.sl: Pred izklopom napajanja uporabi gumb Ugasni v zgornjem meniju (sync + poweroff).
dash.system_hint.en: Before cutting power, use the Shut down button in the top menu (sync + poweroff).

set.intro.sl: Nastavitve so združene po sklopih. Spremembe krmilnika zahtevajo aktivno MAVLink povezavo.
set.intro.en: Settings are grouped into sections. Flight controller changes require an active MAVLink connection.

set.warning_login_required.sl: Za spreminjanje nastavitev je potrebna prijava.
set.warning_login_required.en: Sign in is required to change settings.

set.fc_hint.sl: ARMING_MAGTHRESH [mG] določa največjo dovoljeno razliko magnetnega polja. Vrednost 0 izklopi preverjanje in je primerna samo za bench. RTL_ALT [m] je višina vrnitve domov po koncu misije (na krmilniku v cm).
set.fc_hint.en: ARMING_MAGTHRESH [mG] sets the maximum allowed magnetic field difference. A value of 0 disables the check and is suitable for bench use only. RTL_ALT [m] is the return-to-home altitude after the mission ends (stored in cm on the controller).

set.tf_hint.sl: Test 1 (vzlet) in Test 2 (skok) imata ločene parametre, vključno z GPS pragovi (sateliti, HDOP).
set.tf_hint.en: Test 1 (takeoff) and Test 2 (hop) have separate parameters, including GPS thresholds (satellites, HDOP).

set.mav_hint.sl: Te zagonske vrednosti se spreminjajo v datoteki .env. Trenutna faza: USB @ 115200; za UART TELEM2 nastavi UAV_SERIAL_DEVICE=/dev/serial0 in UAV_SERIAL_BAUD=921600.
set.mav_hint.en: These startup values are changed in the .env file. Current phase: USB @ 115200; for UART TELEM2 set UAV_SERIAL_DEVICE=/dev/serial0 and UAV_SERIAL_BAUD=921600.

set.cap_hint.sl: Izbira napravo mounta na /mnt/uav-data in jo shrani za naslednje zagone. Telemetrija in slike se zapisujejo samo na izbrani medij.
set.cap_hint.en: The selection mounts the device at /mnt/uav-data and saves it for subsequent boots. Telemetry and images are written only to the selected media.

login.intro.sl: Prijava je potrebna za upravljanje letalnika (povezava s krmilnikom, prenos misije, armanje, zagon). Nacrtovanje misij in ogled telemetrije sta dostopna brez prijave.
login.intro.en: Sign in is required to control the aircraft (connecting to the flight controller, uploading the mission, arming, launch). Mission planning and telemetry viewing are available without signing in.

tf.hero_intro.sl: Dva testa: (1) vzlet, lebdenje in pristanek; (2) vzlet, 2 m sever, slika, vrnitev, slika, pristanek. Namen je preveriti verigo ukazov in kamero, ne leteti misije.
tf.hero_intro.en: Two tests: (1) takeoff, hover and land; (2) takeoff, 2 m north, capture, return, capture, land. The goal is to verify the command chain and the camera, not to fly a mission.

tf.warning_1.sl: Propelerji se bodo zavrteli. Pred zagonom: območje v polmeru 10 m prosto (za skok tudi prostor proti
tf.warning_1.en: The propellers will spin up. Before starting: keep the area within a 10 m radius clear (for the hop also clear space toward the

tf.warning_2.sl: ), RC oddajnik vklopljen in v roki, prst na stikalu za preklop v ročni način. Stani
tf.warning_2.en: ), RC transmitter on and in hand, finger on the switch for manual-mode override. Stand

tf.warning_3.sl: od drona, ne proti smeri leta. Ta stran ne nadomešča pilota.
tf.warning_3.en: from the drone, not in the flight path. This page does not replace the pilot.

tf.locked.sl: Za upravljanje letalnika je potrebna prijava.

tf.params_hint.sl: Test 1 in Test 2 imata ločene GPS pragove (sateliti, HDOP). Višina je omejena na 10 m · Shrani zapiše oboje v bazo na napravi.
tf.params_hint.en: Test 1 and Test 2 have separate GPS thresholds (satellites, HDOP). Altitude is capped at 10 m · Save writes both to the on-device database.

tf.force_title.sl: Če se zaporedje zacikla: takoj odkleni UI, LAND / force-disarm
tf.force_title.en: If the sequence stalls: immediately unlock the UI, LAND / force-disarm

tf.log_empty.en: The sequence has not been run yet.

tf.foot.sl: Zapis telemetrije se samodejno začne ob vzletu; najdeš ga med letalnimi logi. Za slike mora teči camera-trigger na RPi.
tf.foot.en: Telemetry logging starts automatically at takeoff; find it among the flight logs. For captures, the camera trigger must be running on the RPi.

mc.no_connection.en: No connection to the flight controller

mc.hint.sl: Letalnik mora biti DISARMED. Po zagonu ga počasi obračaj v vse smeri (kot žogo), dokler napredek ne pride do 100 % / uspeh.
mc.hint.en: The aircraft must be DISARMED. After starting, slowly rotate it in all directions (like a ball) until progress reaches 100 % / success.

mc.thresh_hint.sl: ARMING_MAGTHRESH [mG]: največja dovoljena razlika magnetnega polja glede na model Zemlje (xy). Privzeto 100 — napaka »xy diff:102>100« pomeni, da si samo malo čez. 0 izklopi preverjanje (samo bench / po tehtnem razmisleku).
mc.thresh_hint.en: ARMING_MAGTHRESH [mG]: the maximum allowed magnetic-field difference versus the Earth model (xy). Default 100 — the error "xy diff:102>100" means you are only slightly over. 0 disables the check (bench only / after careful consideration).

gal.intro.sl: Posnetki dejansko odletenih misij. Placeholderji in testni JPEG-i niso prikazani.
gal.intro.en: Images from actually flown missions. Placeholders and test JPEGs are not shown.

plan.hint.sl: Dotik / vlek na karti · Izbriši gumb ali DEL · ESC prekliče orodje
plan.hint.en: Tap / drag on the map · Delete button or DEL · ESC cancels the tool

main.sys_warn_critical.en: ⚠ {issues} (now)! Replace the power supply or reduce the load.

main.sys_warn_brownout.sl: ⚠ Brownout v zgodovini (od boot-a). Spremljaj napajanje.
main.sys_warn_brownout.en: ⚠ Brownout in history (since boot). Monitor the power supply.

main.cam_load_when_visible.sl: Kamera se naloži, ko je vidna…

main.mission_summary.en: {wpCount} waypoint(s), {mapCount} map element(s) · takeoff {alt} m, speed {speed} m/s

main.testflight_min_points.sl: Misija mora imeti vsaj 2 tocki za test let.
main.testflight_min_points.en: The mission must have at least 2 points for a test flight.

ctrl.arm_confirm.sl: ARM zavrti motorje. Je območje prosto in so propelerji preverjeni?
ctrl.arm_confirm.en: ARM spins up the motors. Is the area clear and are the propellers checked?

ctrl.start_confirm.sl:
Zagon misije: ARM → AUTO → MISSION_START.
Po potrebi najprej GUIDED (ArduCopter ne arma v AUTO).
Dron bo vzletel. Nadaljujem?
ctrl.start_confirm.en:
Start mission: ARM → AUTO → MISSION_START.
If needed, GUIDED first (ArduCopter will not arm in AUTO).
The drone will take off. Continue?

ctrl.rtl_confirm.sl: Preklapljam v RTL — dron se bo vrnil na vzletišče. Nadaljujem?
ctrl.rtl_confirm.en: Switching to RTL — the drone will return to the launch point. Continue?

ctrl.connect_usb.sl: Priklopi USB ključek za telemetrijo in slike.
ctrl.connect_usb.en: Connect a USB stick for telemetry and images.

auto.events.empty.en: Sequence has not been run yet.

auto.tip.checks.en: Preflight checks are not yet satisfied.

auto.confirm.nogps.sl: GPS NI ZAHTEVAN — brez GPS se dron ne bo držal pozicije!
auto.confirm.nogps.en: GPS NOT REQUIRED — without GPS the drone will not hold position!

auto.confirm.hop.sl:
Test 2 — skok:
• vzlet na {alt} m
• {leg} m proti severu + slika
• vrnitev + slika
• pristanek

Zahteva ≥{sats} satelitov, HDOP ≤{hdop}.
Je prostor proti severu prost in imaš RC v roki?{extra}
auto.confirm.hop.en:
Test 2 — hop:
• take off to {alt} m
• {leg} m north + photo
• return + photo
• land

Requires ≥{sats} satellites, HDOP ≤{hdop}.
Is the area to the north clear and do you have the RC in hand?{extra}

auto.confirm.hover.sl:
Test 1 — vzlet:
Dron bo vzletel na {alt} m, lebdel {hover} s in pristal.
Zahteva ≥{sats} satelitov, HDOP ≤{hdop}.
Je območje prosto in imaš RC oddajnik v roki?{extra}
auto.confirm.hover.en:
Test 1 — takeoff:
The drone will take off to {alt} m, hover {hover} s and land.
Requires ≥{sats} satellites, HDOP ≤{hdop}.
Is the area clear and do you have the RC transmitter in hand?{extra}

auto.confirm.force.sl:
FORCE CANCEL: takoj prekine zaporedje, odklene vmesnik in pošlje LAND / force-disarm.

Uporabi, če se test zacikla. Nadaljuj?
auto.confirm.force.en:
FORCE CANCEL: immediately aborts the sequence, unlocks the interface and sends LAND / force-disarm.

Use this if the test gets stuck in a loop. Continue?

sset.magthresh_zero_confirm.en: ARMING_MAGTHRESH = 0 disables the PreArm check. Continue?

sset.no_fc_connection.en: No connection to the flight controller

Naprava bo odmountana z morebitne trenutne lokacije in trajno mountana na /mnt/uav-data.
sset.use_device_confirm.en:
Use {device} for telemetry and images?
The device will be unmounted from any current location and permanently mounted at /mnt/uav-data.

smc.no_connection.sl: ● Brez povezave s krmilnikom — najprej poveži na Nadzoru

smc.hint_idle.en: The aircraft must be DISARMED. After starting, slowly rotate it in all directions.

smc.hint_armed.sl: Kalibracija ni dovoljena, dokler je letalnik armiran.
smc.hint_armed.en: Calibration is not allowed while the aircraft is armed.

smc.hint_success.sl: Kalibracija končana. Offseti so shranjeni. Lahko se vrneš na Nadzor.
smc.hint_success.en: Calibration complete. Offsets are saved. You can return to the Control page.

smc.hint_failed.sl: Kalibracija ni uspela. Poskusi znova stran od kovine in motorjev.
smc.hint_failed.en: Calibration failed. Try again away from metal and motors.

smc.hint_running.sl: Počasi obračaj dron v vse smeri (kot žogo), dokler ne prideš do 100 %.
smc.hint_running.en: Slowly rotate the drone in all directions (like a ball) until you reach 100%.

smc.auth_required.en: {error} — open the Control page and log in.

smc.start_confirm.sl:

Start compass calibration?

Continue?
